title: Clark's first trombone and the King trombone he ordered
summary: Clark bought his first trombone for $40 from a Shrine Band player. After about eight years he ordered a King trombone with a five and a half inch bell for $225.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Where'd you get your first trombone?

My first trombone? I bought that trombone from a man that used to play in the Shrine Band. And he told me, Dave was teaching me at that time, and I told him I wanted to buy one so I could have it to practice at home. And he saw this man that played in the Shrine Band and he bought it from me. And I only paid $40 for it. And I kept that trombone, oh I guess about eight years or nine years. Then I was looking in a catalog one day from H.N. White. They built a King instrument. And I saw a trombone in there that I liked. And I ordered that trombone and it had a five and a half inch bell.

Small bell, yeah. And I ordered that horn. That horn cost me $225 at that time. And I kept that horn until I went on the bass. But I was forced on the bass overnight. Yeah, we had a funeral for the Young Men Olympia. And Dominic Raimi was leading the band at that time, which we called him T-Boy. And we had hired Professor Dalmas, I guess you know him.
